plugin.name: mush_windows
plugin.author: Mark
plugin.purpose: Shared window chrome (drag/resize/min/max/close/snap) plus a Windows menu

muclient.script:
local MENU_KEY = "Ctrl+Shift+W" local MENU_ANCHOR = "mush_windows_menu_anchor" local ABSOLUTE_LOCATION = 2 -- WindowCreate flag bits local TRANSPARENT = 4
local windows = {} -- winframe id -> { left, top, w, h, title, owner, visible }
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Windows menu -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Ordered alphabetically by title, so the menu doesn't reshuffle between -- openings. local function SortedIds() local ids = {} for id in pairs(windows) do ids[#ids + 1] = id end table.sort(ids, function(a, b) return (windows[a].title or a) < (windows[b].title or b) end) return ids end
-- WindowMenu treats '|' as the item separator and a leading - + ^ ! > < -- as item flags, so keep titles from being misread as either. local function MenuLabel(title) title = title:gsub("|", "/") if title:match("^[-+^!<>]") then title = " " .. title end return title end
local SHOW_ALL, HIDE_ALL = "Show all", "Hide all"
function WfShowWindowsMenu() local ids = SortedIds() local items, labels = {}, {} for i, id in ipairs(ids) do local rec = windows[id] labels[i] = MenuLabel(rec.title or id) items[i] = (rec.visible and "+" or "") .. labels[i] end if #ids == 0 then items[1] = "^(no windows yet)" else items[#items + 1] = "-" items[#items + 1] = SHOW_ALL items[#items + 1] = HIDE_ALL end
-- WindowMenu returns the chosen item's text ("" if dismissed). Strip any -- check/disabled flag in case it comes back with the text, then match it -- against what we built; two windows with the same title resolve to the -- first one. -- The point has to fall inside the anchor window: MUSHclient silently -- returns "" without showing anything for a point outside it. local choice = (WindowMenu(MENU_ANCHOR, 0, 0, table.concat(items, "|")) or ""):gsub("^[+^]+", "") if choice == "" or #ids == 0 then return end
local function act(id, show) local rec = windows[id] if rec and rec.owner then pcall(CallPlugin, rec.owner, show and "WinframeActivate" or "WinframeHide", id) end end
if choice == SHOW_ALL or choice == HIDE_ALL then for _, id in ipairs(ids) do act(id, choice == SHOW_ALL) end return end for i, id in ipairs(ids) do if labels[i] == choice then act(id, not windows[id].visible) return end end end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Window-geometry registry, called into via CallPlugin by winframe.lua -- (running inside each CONSUMER plugin's own Lua state -- see the header -- comment above). -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function WF_Registry_Update(id, left, top, w, h, title, owner, visible) windows[id] = { left = left, top = top, w = w, h = h, title = title, owner = owner, visible = visible } return true end
function WF_Registry_Remove(id) windows[id] = nil return true end
-- Returns every OTHER registered window's geometry (excludeId omitted) as -- one packed string: "id1:left,top,w,h|id2:left,top,w,h|...". Packed into -- a single string because CallPlugin can only return one plain value, not -- a table. Used for snapping only, so title/owner/visible aren't included. function WF_Registry_Get(excludeId) local parts = {} for id, rec in pairs(windows) do if id ~= excludeId then parts[#parts + 1] = id .. ":" .. rec.left .. "," .. rec.top .. "," .. rec.w .. "," .. rec.h end end return table.concat(parts, "|") end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Prompt service (see the comment above <triggers>) -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
MW_BROADCAST_PROMPT = 1 MW_BROADCAST_PROMPT_CHANGED = 2
local function Note(msg) ColourNote("orange", "", "[mush_windows] " .. msg) end
local function PluginDir() local dir = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 20) or "" if dir ~= "" and dir:sub(-1) ~= "/" and dir:sub(-1) ~= "\\" then dir = dir .. "/" end return dir end
local position = { x = nil, y = nil } local promptConfig = nil -- { lines = { regex, ... }, coords = { { line=, pattern=, xGroup=, yGroup= }, ... } } local promptCapture = { active = false, lines = {} } local hideCoords = true local coordTriggerSpecs = {} -- trigger name -> coords entry
local function EscapeRegex(s) return (s:gsub("([%^%$%(%)%%%.%[%]%*%+%-%?{}|\\])", "\\%1")) end
-- Converts one line of the |TOKEN| template into a regex. local function BuildLineRegex(line) local pattern = "^" local xGroup, yGroup = nil, nil local groupIdx = 0 local pos = 1 while true do local s, e, token = line:find("|([^|]-)|", pos) if not s then pattern = pattern .. EscapeRegex(line:sub(pos)) break end if s > pos then pattern = pattern .. EscapeRegex(line:sub(pos, s - 1)) end local ename = (token:match("^([^%*]+)") or token):lower()
if ename == "xcoord" then groupIdx = groupIdx + 1 xGroup = groupIdx pattern = pattern .. "(-?\\d+)" elseif ename == "ycoord" then groupIdx = groupIdx + 1 yGroup = groupIdx pattern = pattern .. "(-?\\d+)" elseif ename == "colour" or ename == "color" then -- zero-width: assumes the trigger matches against colour-stripped text elseif ename == "pipe" then pattern = pattern .. "\\|" elseif ename == "space" then pattern = pattern .. " " else pattern = pattern .. ".*?" end pos = e + 1 end return pattern .. "$", xGroup, yGroup end
-- The game hard-wraps long output at a fixed column width, which can split -- a |TOKEN| in half across two physical lines -- without dropping or -- adding any characters, so the fix is to rejoin everything into one -- continuous string before looking for |NEWLINE| tokens, rather than -- trusting physical line boundaries. local function SplitOnNewlineToken(text) local logicalLines = {} local pos = 1 while true do local s, e = text:find("|NEWLINE|", pos, true) if not s then logicalLines[#logicalLines + 1] = text:sub(pos) break end logicalLines[#logicalLines + 1] = text:sub(pos, s - 1) pos = e + 1 end return logicalLines end
local function InstallCoordTriggers() for name in pairs(coordTriggerSpecs) do DeleteTrigger(name) end coordTriggerSpecs = {} if not promptConfig then return end
-- flags: enabled(1) + regexp(32) + replace-if-exists(1024) = 1057, -- plus omit-from-output(4) when the coordinate line should be hidden. local flags = 1057 + (hideCoords and 4 or 0) for i, spec in ipairs(promptConfig.coords) do local name = "mw_coord_" .. i AddTriggerEx(name, spec.pattern, "", flags, -1, 0, "", "MwOnCoordLine", 0, 100) coordTriggerSpecs[name] = spec spec.isLast = (i == #promptConfig.coords) end end
local function SavePromptConfig() local path = PluginDir() .. "prompt_config.lua" local f, err = io.open(path, "w") if not f then Note("could not save prompt_config.lua: " .. tostring(err)) return end f:write("-- Auto-generated by wf_prompt_setup from your 'prompt settings' output.\n") f:write("return {\n lines = {\n") for _, pattern in ipairs(promptConfig.lines) do f:write(string.format(" %q,\n", pattern)) end f:write(" },\n coords = {\n") for _, spec in ipairs(promptConfig.coords) do f:write(string.format(" { line = %d, pattern = %q, xGroup = %s, yGroup = %s },\n", spec.line, spec.pattern, tostring(spec.xGroup), tostring(spec.yGroup))) end f:write(" },\n}\n") f:close() end
local function LoadPromptConfig() local chunk = loadfile(PluginDir() .. "prompt_config.lua") if not chunk then return false end local ok, cfg = pcall(chunk) if not ok or type(cfg) ~= "table" or not cfg.lines or not cfg.coords or #cfg.coords == 0 then return false end promptConfig = cfg InstallCoordTriggers() return true end
function MW_PromptSetup() Note("requesting your prompt format...") Send("prompt settings") return true end
function MwStartPromptCapture() promptCapture.active = true promptCapture.lines = {} MwResetPromptTimer() end
function MwResetPromptTimer() DeleteTimer("mw_prompt_done") -- flags: enabled(1) + one-shot(4) = 5 AddTimer("mw_prompt_done", 0, 0, 0.4, "", 5, "MwFinishPromptCapture") end
function MwFinishPromptCapture() promptCapture.active = false local lines = promptCapture.lines
if #lines == 0 then Note("got no template lines back from 'prompt settings' -- is a custom prompt active? " .. "(try 'prompt set |HP|:|SP|>|NEWLINE|X:[|XCOORD|]Y:[|YCOORD|]' first)") return end
local logicalLines = SplitOnNewlineToken(table.concat(lines, "")) -- A template ending in |NEWLINE| leaves an empty logical line after it, -- which the game never actually prints. if #logicalLines > 1 and logicalLines[#logicalLines] == "" then logicalLines[#logicalLines] = nil end
local cfg = { lines = {}, coords = {} } for i, line in ipairs(logicalLines) do local pattern, xGroup, yGroup = BuildLineRegex(line) cfg.lines[i] = pattern if xGroup or yGroup then cfg.coords[#cfg.coords + 1] = { line = i, pattern = pattern, xGroup = xGroup, yGroup = yGroup } end end
if #cfg.coords == 0 then Note("your prompt template doesn't contain |XCOORD| / |YCOORD|. " .. "Add them with 'prompt set ...' and run wf_prompt_setup again.") return end
promptConfig = cfg InstallCoordTriggers() SavePromptConfig() BroadcastPlugin(MW_BROADCAST_PROMPT_CHANGED, "") Note("prompt read: " .. #cfg.lines .. " line(s), position from " .. #cfg.coords .. " of them.") end
function OnPluginLineReceived(text) if promptCapture.active and text ~= "Your prompt:" then if text:find("|", 1, true) then table.insert(promptCapture.lines, text) MwResetPromptTimer() else -- Every line of the template has |TOKENS|; the first line without -- any is the game's real prompt printed right after it, which must -- not be read as more template. DeleteTimer("mw_prompt_done") MwFinishPromptCapture() end end return true end
function MwOnCoordLine(name, line, wildcards) local spec = coordTriggerSpecs[name] if not spec then return end if spec.xGroup then position.x = tonumber(wildcards[spec.xGroup]) end if spec.yGroup then position.y = tonumber(wildcards[spec.yGroup]) end if spec.isLast then BroadcastPlugin(MW_BROADCAST_PROMPT, MW_GetPosition()) end end
function MW_GetPosition() return (position.x or "") .. "," .. (position.y or "") end
function MW_GetPromptLines() if not promptConfig then return "" end local last = promptConfig.coords[#promptConfig.coords].line return table.concat(promptConfig.lines, "\n") .. "\n" .. last end
function MW_SetHideCoords(state) hideCoords = (state == "1" or state == true) SetVariable("hide_coords", hideCoords and "1" or "0") InstallCoordTriggers() Note(hideCoords and "the coordinate line will now be hidden from your output." or "the coordinate line will now be shown again.") return true end
function MwHideCoordsAlias() MW_SetHideCoords("1") end function MwShowCoordsAlias() MW_SetHideCoords("0") end
function OnPluginInstall() ColourNote("orange", "", "[mush_windows] ready -- " .. MENU_KEY .. " opens the Windows menu.")
local savedHide = GetVariable("hide_coords") if savedHide ~= nil then hideCoords = savedHide == "1" end if not LoadPromptConfig() then Note("prompt not read yet -- make sure your prompt includes |XCOORD| and |YCOORD| " .. "(see 'help prompt'), then type: wf_prompt_setup") end
WindowCreate(MENU_ANCHOR, 0, 0, 1, 1, 12, ABSOLUTE_LOCATION + TRANSPARENT, 0x000000) WindowShow(MENU_ANCHOR, true)
Accelerator(MENU_KEY, "wf_windows") end
function OnPluginClose() Accelerator(MENU_KEY, "") WindowDelete(MENU_ANCHOR) end
